messages:
marta (docs): small PR to fix an SDK snippet stalled due to 2 required reviews. can we have an exemption for trivial docs edits?
kevin (eng): GH doesn't let you change required-review counts by path. we typically use an automation bot that approves docs-only PRs after some quick checks.
marta (docs): what quick checks are enough? link-check + md-lint? run examples?
tyler (infra): recommend: 1) detect docs-only via git diff, 2) run markdown lint and link-checker, 3) run any code-block smoke tests for snippet languages present, 4) bot posts a review approval and a short audit comment with changed files.
ci-bot: reminder: auto-merge still needs all required status checks green and no outstanding review requests.
olivia (security): exclude /legal, /security, /brand from auto-approve. also ensure bot approval shows which checks ran.
tyler (infra): draft plan: add CODEOWNERS entry for /docs -> @redwood-docs, GH Action 'docs-auto-approve' that runs on PR, posts approval with a link to files, and adds label 'docs-auto-ok'. will keep docs-preview optional for docs-only PRs to avoid flakes.
marta (docs): can we also add a PR template that asks authors to add [docs] prefix or the docs-only label? detection gets trickier otherwise.
tyler (infra): yes. I'll open a draft PR with the workflow, sample CODEOWNERS line, and PR template. will include a deny-list for sensitive dirs.
kevin (eng): test carefully with a forked branch to validate bot token scopes and that approvals count towards required reviews.
marta (docs): thanks — I'll queue a tiny link-fix test after the draft is merged. :thumbsup:
